description: Minimum Core status and provenance policy/contract. Documents semantics only -- no workflow engine, no migration, no masterdata changes. See docs/development/CORE_STATUS_PROVENANCE.md for the normative explanation and docs/development/CORE_VERSIONING.md for the related version model.

definitions.draft: Proposed or in progress. Must not be treated as verified canonical truth by products or agents.
definitions.reviewed: Reviewed by a human/professional process. Not necessarily documented well enough yet to be verified.
definitions.verified: Approved as Core's best verified representation at this point in time. Requires sufficient provenance for the kind of claim/data involved. Does not mean eternal truth.
definitions.deprecated: Must not be used as the current canonical representation. Kept when history/backward-compatibility requires it. Should reference a replacement/superseding entry where relevant.

status.rollback_or_reopen_note: Not decided in this round. If a real need arises, report it rather than pre-designing it here.

definitions.documented_fact: A directly documented, sourced fact (e.g. a value taken from a supplier datasheet).
definitions.documented_observation: A recorded observation, not necessarily a settled fact (e.g. Brew Lab sensory notes on a specific batch).
definitions.interpretation: A reasoned interpretation of underlying facts/observations.
definitions.assumption: An explicit, stated assumption, not yet confirmed.
definitions.proposal: A suggested change or addition (e.g. from a future crawler/import step) that has not been reviewed or accepted.

confidence_field.note: Deliberately excluded -- would duplicate either status (quality-assurance progress) or claim_evidence_type (kind of claim). See docs/development/CORE_STATUS_PROVENANCE.md section 4.

legacy_verified_mapping_note: No automatic mapping exists from the legacy per-entry verified:true/false boolean in data/master_*.json to any Core status value. verified:true does not imply Core status verified; verified:false does not imply Core status draft; a missing verified field implies no Core status. Any future mapping requires a separate, explicit, reviewed rule -- this policy does not perform or authorize one.
